versions.content: void Rte_[<client>_]RptHook_<cts>_<var>_Transmit ([const Rte_CDS_<cts> * ], <type> * <buffer> ) Where <cts> is the component type symbol of the Atomic- SwComponentType , <var> the identifying name of the RP global buffer , e.g. port and data element names. <buffer> is a refer- ence to the RP global buffer . The instance handle is included if and only if the software compo- nent's supportsMultipleInstantiation attribute is set to true. Note that Rte_Instance cannot be used directly, as there will be pointers to multiple components' structure types within the single VFB Tracing header file, and Rte_Instance would therefore be ambigu- ous.
